en.bdb: Nature of service by the disciples

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਛਡਿ ਮਣੀ ਮਨੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi chhadd manee manooree|

en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru, falling at the feet (of Guru) forswears his ego and desires of mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਹਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਮਜੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: paanee pakhaa peehanaa nit karai majooree|

en.bdb: He fetches water, fans the congregation, grinds flour (for latigar) and does all manual jobs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਪੜ ਝਾੜਿ ਵਿਛਾਇੰਦਾ ਚੁਲਿ ਝੋਕਿ ਨ ਝੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: trapaR jhaaR vichhai(n)dhaa chul jhok na jhooree|

en.bdb: He cleanses and spreads the sheets and gets not dejected while putting fire in the hearth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਦੇ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕ ਸਬੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: muradhe vaa(n)g mureedh hoi kar sidhak sabooree|

en.bdb: He adopts the contentment like a dead person does.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿੰਮਲਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਹਜੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan hovai si(n)malahu fal vaas hajooree|

en.bdb: He gets such a fruit of living near the Guru, as the silk-cotton tree gets by being near the sandal tree i.e. it also becomes fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee gurmukh mat pooree ||19||

en.bdb: The Sikhs loving the Guru make their wisdom complete.
